Enhance your warehouse operations with SAP EWM expertise
In today's fast-paced logistics landscape, efficient and optimized warehouse management is critical for business success. Market Cloud empowers you to unlock the full potential of your warehouse operations with our comprehensive suite of SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) solutions. Our team of seasoned SAP EWM consultants possesses extensive experience in implementing, integrating, and optimizing this powerful warehouse management system. We act as your trusted advisor, helping you leverage SAP EWM to streamline processes, improve inventory control, and achieve greater supply chain visibility.

Activate Business Configuration Sets (BC-Sets):
Activate Business Configuration Sets (BC-Sets) and build your new embedded EWM landscape on SAP S/4HANA.
Migrations steps for SAP S/4 HANA EWM
Ensure legacy ECC storage location and decentralised EWM warehouse numbers remain consistent in the EWM organizational structure to avoid impacting MRP and ATP.
Custom Code Migration and Adjustment:
Use Transport Organizer Tools (SE03) to transport custom code from the source to the target system.
Create transport requests to move scoped custom code to the target system.
Run ATC checks or Custom Code Impact Analysis to identify necessary code changes.
Manage Central Customizing:
Configure all EWM customizing directly in the embedded EWM system.
Replicate central master data from ERP to S/4HANA for relevant objects like customers, vendors, carriers, materials, and batches.
Central Master Data Replication from ERP (ECC & Decentral)
SAP HANA Logistics functional roles (MM, SD, PPOM) are responsible for replicating master data from ERP (ECC & Decentral) systems to S/4HANA for the following objects:
Customers
Vendors
Carriers
Materials
Batches
Note:
Once materials are replicated to S/4HANA, they automatically generate product master data in embedded EWM.
Only the extension of product master data needs to be done in the embedded EWM system.
Managing Local Customizing:
Copy EWM-specific configuration from the source Business Suite EWM system to the target EWM system on S/4HANA.
Transport customizing settings, including BC-Sets and SCMP table comparisons.
Differentiate between warehouse-independent and warehouse-specific customizing.
Pre-Cutover Activities:
Handle and close open business documents like stock transfers, physical inventory documents, and work orders.
Perform a thorough cleanup of stock, RFC queues, IDOCs, and other relevant data.
Classify documents by status and finish those that have been started.
Operationally stop delivery distribution to EWM in the days leading up to the migration weekend.
EWM Stock Migration (Cutover Activity):
Migrate EWM stock and perform stock reconciliation for quantity in EWM and sign-off.
Activate Interfaces:
Activate interfaces for transactional data transfer after the go-live.
